To my Naddy… ♡
✦
To my Naddy… ♡

Well, you adopted me when we were in class 6 from coaching. I was sitting alone. I didn't have much of a friend… I was lonely. And somehow, without me even trying, I gained you.

I know I am the best, that's why you chose me. 😌
And it's your 4th birthday with me.

I'm not really good at expressing feelings, but I hope we can stay together forever. I hope neither of us changes.
(Although… you have changed a lil bit. 🙄)

Ami jokhon first 6-e school-e jai, dekhtesilam ekta glass pora, hijab pora cute dekhte meye captain-giri kortase. First impression eitai chilo.

Then, vaggo-krome amra eki coaching-e jai, ar tui amake tor shathe boshar jonno dakish.

And that's it.

Tarpor theke ki hoilo ke jane… We just became friends, then somehow… friends forever. ♡

Jani toke tor onek friend wish korbe, but I wanted to be different. I don't have many friends, and I hope you will never make me a “no-friend person.” 😭

Well, auntie-ke thanks je emon biraler moto moody ekta meye poida korse. 🐈
Happy poida dibosh, btw. 😭🎂

Well, etto boro paragraph likhlam just to remind you that you have a tall, cute lil bff — and she will always stay with you…

until you choose someone else. :)

Why the fuck am I even behaving like a possessive wife? Idk. 😭

Anyway…

Happy happy happiest birthday, Naddy. ♡
Please don't forget my treat. Monā. 🎂

And if you ever forget everything else from this little page, remember this:

Some people enter your life quietly.
You just sit beside them one day…
and somehow, years later, you realize they became home.

I'm really glad I got you. ♡

Happy Birthday, Naddy. ♡

I hope this year is kind to you. I hope you keep laughing, keep being annoyingly moody, keep being the person who somehow makes ordinary days feel less ordinary. And I hope, years from now, we're still looking back at this and saying, “remember when we were like this?”
